Docker-based .NET 8 stack: MS SQL Server 2025, PostgreSQL 16, Azure Service Bus Emulator; Docker Compose v2+, PowerShell 5.1+.

.\stack.ps1 start
.\stack.ps1 stop
.\stack.ps1 restart
.\stack.ps1 nuke
.\stack.ps1 status
.\stack.ps1 logs [service]
.\stack.ps1 pull
.\stack.ps1 monitor
docker compose up -d
docker compose down
docker compose down -v
cd servicebus/monitor

Copy `.env.example` → `.env` and fill in all placeholder values. **Never commit `.env`** (it is in `.gitignore`).
Never commit `.env` or `servicebus/Config.json`.
Every service must have a `healthcheck` block.
No secrets in source — `.env` is git-ignored.
Password complexity — SQL Server passwords must meet: min 8 characters, mixed case, at least one digit, at least one special character.
No CI/CD pipelines.
No test infrastructure.
PowerShell 5.1+ compatibility — do not introduce syntax that requires PowerShell 7+.
Keep `.env.example` and `Config.example.json` in sync.
